title: 36 Hours in Rome
abstract: The Eternal City is getting a refresh, with new restaurants and hotels, sumptuous art palaces and innovative ways to see ancient sites.

title: 36 Hours in Wellington, New Zealand
abstract: New Zealand’s pint-size and vertiginous capital has spectacular views, excellent dining and a one-of-a-kind bird sanctuary.

title: 36 Hours in Seoul
abstract: Hike fortress walls without leaving the city limits, go to an “LP bar” and enjoy stir-fried intestines at a baseball game: only in Seoul.

title: 36 Hours in London
abstract: Up for a flavorful London weekend? Stuff yourself royally with a “full English” and a Sunday roast, journey into the literary heart of the city and stroll along the Queen’s Walk.

title: 36 Hours in Essaouira, Morocco
abstract: With camels roaming the beaches, centuries-old city walls and abundant art galleries, Essaouira is coastal Morocco at its most picturesque.
